svg.title: Immanuel: God with us
svg.desc: Immanuel, עִמָּנוּ אֵל: God with us. they shall call his name Immanuel” (which means, God with us). (Matthew 1:23 (ESV)). In the scene: the star came to rest over the place where the child was (Matthew 2:9); the house (2:11).
svg.text: they shall call his name Immanuel”
In the scene: the star came to rest over the place where the child was (Matthew 2:9); the house (2:11).
